anchor.description: Relative Binding Free Energy (RBFE) alchemical perturbation pipeline using OpenFE. Computes DDG (kcal/mol) between two ligands competing for the same binding site via lambda-window replica exchange on GPU (OpenMM 8). Steps: RDKit + OpenFF Sage 2.2 ligand prep; PDBFixer + AmberFF14SB protein prep; Lomap2 MCS atom-mapping; OpenFE SepTop/RBFE protocol; MBAR analysis with Cinnabar. anchor.description: P0 PKPD pipeline validation against published human semaglutide data. Runs a 2-compartment SC pharmacokinetic model with a GLP-1R Emax body-weight PD model, then validates predictions against Overgaard 2019 (Diabetes Therapy) PK reference and SUSTAIN-1 (Sorli 2017 Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol) PD reference. Pass criteria: predicted Cmax/AUCtau within 30% of Overgaard; 30-week body weight change between -3.0 and -6.0 kg (SUSTAIN-1 mean -4.53 kg). Input: dose_mg, n_weeks, PK params (CL/V1/Q/V2/ka/F). Output: pkpd_validation.json (pass/fail per metric), pk_profile.csv, pd_curve.csv.

anchor.tools_used: fpocket (Le Guilloux 2009), Schmidtke & Barril 2010 druggability score
anchor.description: fpocket-based binding-site detection and druggability assessment for a protein target. Detects binding cavities in a PDB structure and scores each pocket by volume (A^3), druggability score (0-1, Schmidtke & Barril 2010), hydrophobicity index, and polarity fraction. Applies an evidence-graded QC gate: PASS if best pocket druggability >= min_druggability AND volume >= min_volume; WARN if druggability >= warn_druggability; FAIL otherwise. Input: pdb_input (path or 4-letter PDB ID), min_druggability, min_volume. Output: pockets.csv (ranked), druggability_qc.json (PASS/WARN/FAIL with reasoning).

anchor.input_types: ["smiles"]

For each input SMILES, generates up to max_routes synthesis routes (max_depth tree depth), each scored by step count and feasibility. Applies QC gate: PASS if >=1 route has <=4 steps AND score >=0.6; WARN if best route is 5-6 steps; FAIL if no routes found or all >6 steps. Aggregates per-compound results into HTML report + CSV + QC JSON for CRO integration. Input: smiles_list (one per compound), max_routes, max_depth. Output: routes.json, filtered.tsv, report.html, qc_summary.

Composes nf-core/spatialvi (id 12783) sub-workflow for Space Ranger → SpatialExperiment + VisiumIO → SpatialFeatureExperiment (SFE) conversion + Voyager univariate (Moran's I / Geary's C / Getis-Ord Gi*) + bivariate (Lee's L) + MULTISPATI PCA + spatial spot clustering with per-cluster stratified ESDA. Spatial co-expression: which pairs of genes have correlated expression patterns
GPU-accelerated GWAS over UDIP-derived brain image phenotypes. 4-phase pipeline (phenotype QC, kernel + stratify, TorchGWAS scan, loci report). Wraps github.com/ZhiGroup/TorchGWAS (MIT).
Folding-Docking-Affinity (FDA) protein-ligand affinity screen. 4-phase pipeline (ESMFold target, library docking, FDA affinity head, ranked report with uncertainty). Wraps github.com/ZhiGroup/FDA.
Cross-cancer tumor-reactive CD8+ T-cell prediction from scRNA-seq + spatial. Wraps github.com/bsml320/turep (MIT).

Immune cell polarization scoring and subtype annotation. Re-implements the Scupa method (Zhao lab, bsml320/Scupa) using published gene-set signatures (Tex/Tem/Trm/Teff/Tpex) via scanpy score_genes — no R package dependency. 3-phase: signature scoring → state assignment with confidence → HTML report + ImmuneApp handoff JSON. Applicable to both tumor-infiltrating and autoreactive T cells (RA synovium, SLE kidney). Step 2 of ZZ01 chain: turep → scupa_polarization → immuneapp_hla_screen.
HLA-I epitope binding prediction for neoantigen screening. Wraps github.com/bsml320/ImmuneApp (MIT).
Single-cell-resolved GWAS enrichment for immune cell types. Wraps github.com/bsml320/scGWAS (GPL-3.0).

MAGMA v1.10 gene-based GWAS analysis. 3-phase: SNP annotation → per-gene Z-statistics → box-cox transform for scGWAS input. Bakes g1000_eur LD reference + NCBI37/38 gene location files. Emits .magma_boxcox.txt compatible with scgwas_immune_cell. Wraps ctg.cncr.nl/software/magma (academic freeware). Used by Zhao lab Genome Biology 2022 (PMC9575201) and Zhi lab Nat Commun 2026 (PMC12458571).

METAL multi-cohort GWAS meta-analysis. 2-phase: prep cohort files + write METAL script → execute METAL → combined sumstats. Supports STDERR (inverse-variance) and SAMPLESIZE schemes. Feeds into magma_gene_analysis and ldsc_heritability. Wraps github.com/statgen/METAL (MIT, Willer et al. Bioinformatics 2010). Used in Zhi lab Nat Commun 2026 (PMC12458571) Methods.

LDSC v1.0.1 SNP-heritability and LD score regression. 3-phase: munge sumstats → h² estimation → QC report with intercept + ratio flags. Bakes eur_w_ld_chr LD scores (22 chr) + w_hm3.snplist. Wraps github.com/bulik/ldsc (GPL-3.0, Bulik-Sullivan et al. Nat Genet 2015). Used in Zhi lab Nat Commun 2026 (PMC12458571) to validate GWAS calibration.

De novo cyclic peptide design pipeline for PPI targets with oral macrocycle optimization. 5-phase pipeline: (A) target pocket analysis with curated autoimmune hotspot DB (IL17A/IL6R/CALCA/PTPN22), (B) CyclicMPNN-compatible sequence design with N-methylation optimization, (C) macrocycle-specific ADMET screening using Yudin 2015 rules (NOT Lipinski -- MW 500-1200 Da, chameleonic potential scoring, effective HBD after N-Me), (D) AlphaFold3 input JSON generation for top-5 candidates, (E) design report with IND-prep summary. Validated against voclosporin/cyclosporin A oral macrolactam precedent. Ta

NVIDIA BioNeMo NIM multi-model drug discovery pipeline. Supports 7 modes: structure prediction (ESMFold, Boltz2, AlphaFold2), backbone+sequence design (RFdiffusion+ProteinMPNN), molecular docking (DiffDock), de novo molecule generation (GenMol+MolMIM+MoFlow), MSA search, Evo2 DNA generation, and full pipeline. All 19 biology models via NVIDIA Cloud Functions API.

Spatial clustering and domain segmentation of 10x Visium data using BANKSY (Bioconductor). Accepts Space Ranger h5 output or pre-processed SpatialExperiment object. Outputs: BANKSY cluster assignments per spot, spatially variable gene list (Moran's I), domain segmentation map. Requires: filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 + spatial/ folder from Space Ranger.

Cell type deconvolution of Visium spots using RCTD (Robust Cell Type Decomposition). Requires 10x Visium spatial matrix + scRNA-seq reference (h5ad or Seurat RDS). Outputs: per-spot cell type proportion matrix, dominant cell type assignments, RCTD confidence scores. Validated against RA synovial Visium (Muller 2024 Ann Rheum Dis GSE243885). Spatially resolved deconvolution: infers immune cell type proportions in each Visium spot from bulk-like spatial expression. Applications: tumor-infiltrating immune cell mapping, spatial immune landscape of tumor biopsies, tumor microenvironment deconvoluti

Outputs: ranked LR interaction table with spatial specificity scores, interaction network per tissue compartment. Applicable to RA synovial, COVID-19 lung, tumor microenvironment.

Python-based spatial transcriptomics analysis using Squidpy. Accepts AnnData h5ad with spatial coordinates (Visium, Xenium, MERFISH, seqFISH+). Computes: Moran's I spatially variable genes, neighborhood enrichment scores, co-occurrence analysis, spatial scatter plots. Integrates with scanpy/AnnData ecosystem.

Integration of spatial transcriptomics with scRNA-seq reference using anchor-based transfer (Seurat v5) or tangram mapping. Maps scRNA-seq cell type labels and gene signatures onto Visium spots. Outputs: deconvoluted spot-level proportions + RNA velocity vectors in spatial context. For autoimmune tissue mapping (RA synovial, lupus nephritis kidney, IBD colon).

Spatial transcriptomics analysis of thymic tissue sections for immune aging studies. Identifies: corticomedullary junction (CMJ) spatial boundary, medullary thymic epithelial cell (mTEC) niches, thymic involution markers (FOXN1, CCL25, DLL4). Benchmarked against Bautista 2021 Nat Immunol thymus involution Visium dataset. Input: Space Ranger output. Output: CMJ boundary coordinates, FOXN1 spatial gradient, T-cell egress zone map.

Evidence-based target positioning for drug discovery. Queries OpenTargets Platform (GraphQL), ChEMBL, ClinicalTrials.gov, and PubMed in parallel to score a gene/protein target across three axes: evidence strength (genetic association, expression, literature), competitive crowding (approved drugs, clinical-stage assets, active trials), and clinical stage of furthest asset. Output: positioning_report.json, evidence_scorecard.csv, competitive_land

Input: condition, orpha_code, target_n, n_sites, trial_phase, trial_duration_months, countries. Output: feasibility_report.json, competing_trials.csv, prevalence_

Input: run_id, workflow_name, input_files, output_fi

anchor.input_types: ["fasta"]
anchor.description: Fast protein/nucleotide sequence homology search with MMseqs2 (MMseqs2-GPU, Nat Methods 2025). Searches a query FASTA against a prebuilt target DB (UniRef/nr/Swiss-Prot, S3-staged read-only). ~6x vs CPU MMseqs2, up to ~177x vs JackHMMER with --gpu 1, at PSI-BLAST-beating sensitivity. Self-hosted GPL — no NVIDIA NIM license.

anchor.input_types: json
anchor.description: AlphaFold 3 structure prediction pipeline. Predicts 3D structures of proteins, nucleic acids, small molecules, and covalent modifications via the AF3 unified diffusion model. State-of-the-art accuracy for protein-ligand and protein-nucleic acid complexes. Input: AF3 fold_input.json (sequences + entity types). Output: predicted .cif structures, per-residue confidence (pLDDT), PAE matrix, ranking_scores.json.

anchor.input_types: fasta
anchor.description: Fast protein structure prediction using ESMFold via the ESM Metagenomic Atlas free API (no API key required, max 400 residues). Single forward pass — ~10s per protein — compared to hours for physics-based methods. Good for rapid structure screening of short sequences. Input: FASTA file. Output: predicted .pdb structure.

anchor.input_types: tsv,txt
anchor.description: GWAS functional annotation pipeline using the FUMA (Functional Mapping and Annotation) web platform. Submits GWAS summary statistics to the FUMA SNP2GENE endpoint, polls for completion, downloads results, and parses: genomic risk loci, MAGMA gene-based test, MAGMA gene-set enrichment analysis (GSA). Reference: Watanabe et al. 2017 Nat Commun 8:1826. Input: GWAS sumstats (SNP CHR BP A1 A2 P columns). Output: fuma_report.json + fuma_report.md with loci, gene hits, pathway enrichment.

anchor.input_types: tsv,txt
anchor.description: MAGMA gene-based GWAS test pipeline. Maps GWAS SNPs to genes with a 35 kb upstream / 10 kb downstream window, then runs the MAGMA gene-based association test against a 1000G reference panel. Outputs ranked gene hits with Bonferroni-corrected p-values. Reference: de Leeuw et al. 2015 PLOS Comput Biol 11(4):e1004219. Input: GWAS sumstats (SNP P columns + sample size), reference panel bfile. Output: magma_report.json + magma_report.md with top gene hits.

anchor.input_types: bed,bim,fam,txt
anchor.description: GCTA mixed linear model association (MLMA) pipeline for genome-wide association studies. Builds a genetic relationship matrix (GRM) from PLINK genotype files, then runs MLMA-LOCO (leaving one chromosome out) to control for population stratification. Outputs per-SNP association statistics with genomic inflation correction. Reference: Yang et al. 2011 Am J Hum Genet 88:76. Input: PLINK .bed/.bim/.fam triplet + phenotype file. Output: gcta_report.json + gcta_report.md with top SNPs, QQ plot data, lambda GC.

anchor.input_types: vcf
anchor.description: AI-MARRVEL rare disease variant prioritization pipeline. Integrates multi-database evidence (ClinVar, OMIM, gnomAD, Orphanet, HGMD) with an ensemble ML model to rank candidate causal variants in exome/genome sequencing data. Designed for Mendelian disease diagnosis. Reference: Liu et al. 2023 NEJM AI 1(6) — 70% top-3 diagnostic accuracy on published rare disease cases. Input: annotated VCF (sarek+VEP output) + comma-separated HPO terms. Output: variant prioritization report JSON + ranked candidate list MD.

anchor.input_types: fasta,uniprot_id
anchor.description: Retrieves pre-computed protein structures from the AlphaFold EBI database (200M+ structures, v4 model) via UniProt accession, or formats input JSON for submission to the free AlphaFold 3 Server (20 jobs/day limit) for new predictions including complexes. Input: UniProt accession ID (for DB lookup) or FASTA (for AF3 server). Output: PDB structure file, optional mmCIF, and per-residue confidence JSON.

anchor.input_types: fasta,sdf
anchor.description: Boltz-2 is a GPU-based protein-ligand structure prediction model that jointly predicts 3D conformations and binding affinities. It accepts a FASTA file plus an optional ligand SDF, and outputs predicted PDB/CIF structures and affinity JSON. Requires 16–40 GB VRAM. Input: FASTA + optional ligand SDF. Output: PDB/CIF structures + binding affinity JSON.

anchor.input_types: fasta,sdf,smiles
anchor.description: Chai-1 is a multi-modal biomolecular structure prediction model supporting proteins, DNA, RNA, ligands (SDF or SMILES), and glycans in a single unified architecture. Requires 24–80 GB VRAM GPU. Input: FASTA (with optional ligand SDF/SMILES). Output: PDB/CIF structures and confidence score JSON.

anchor.input_types: mrcs,star,pkl
anchor.description: Resolves continuous conformational heterogeneity in cryo-EM particle stacks using cryoDRGN (VAE-based latent representation), then performs UMAP + k-means clustering to identify representative conformational states, and scans the ensemble of reconstructed volumes for druggable binding pockets using fpocket. Input: particle MRCS stack (STAR format) + CTF/poses PKL files. Output: heterogeneity report JSON with conformational entropy, population fractions, and per-state druggability scores.

anchor.input_types: fasta,sdf,smiles
anchor.description: Ultra-fast contrastive-learning virtual drug screening that is orders of magnitude faster than traditional docking. Can run locally against a custom compound library (SDF or SMILES) given a protein FASTA, or query the pre-computed DrugCLIP API database via UniProt ID. Input: protein FASTA + compound library SDF/SMILES (local), or UniProt ID (API). Output: scored compound CSV with top hits.

anchor.input_types: fasta,csv
anchor.description: ProFam is a protein family language model for variant fitness scoring and novel sequence generation conditioned on a protein family multiple sequence alignment (MSA) or reference FASTA. Score variants against family fitness landscape, or sample new sequences at a given temperature. Input: conditioning FASTA (family MSA or reference) + candidate sequences FASTA/CSV (for scoring) or MSA alone (for generation). Output: ranked fitness scores CSV or generated FASTA.

anchor.input_types: pdb,fasta
anchor.description: Generates a conformational ensemble for a protein using BioEmu-1 (GPU-based generative model) or an MDAnalysis Gaussian perturbation fallback, then detects cryptic binding pockets across the ensemble using PocketMiner and fpocket, and finally produces a UMAP/PCA projection of the ensemble with RMSD/Rg distributions and a summary report. Input: PDB or FASTA. Output: ensemble tarball, per-frame pocket JSON, UMAP PNG, and summary JSON.

anchor.input_types: fasta,pdb,txt
anchor.description: ProTrek is a trimodal protein search model (100× faster than Foldseek) that searches a large protein database by amino acid sequence, 3D structure, or free-text functional description. Also supports generating embeddings for custom databases. Input: query (sequence string, PDB path, or text description) + query type. Output: ranked hits JSON and TSV with UniProt IDs, scores, and function annotations.

anchor.input_types: pdb
anchor.description: AI-powered single-chain variable fragment (scFv) antibody sequence design using ProteinMPNN, followed by optional AlphaFold2 structure validation. Given a target antigen PDB, generates a pool of designed scFv sequences scored by ProteinMPNN log-likelihood, then predicts structures and confidence for the top designs. Input: target antigen PDB. Output: designed scFv FASTA, scores CSV, and optional predicted PDB structures.

anchor.input_types: fasta,txt
anchor.description: Generates and scores siRNA candidates from an input mRNA sequence using the industry-standard Ui-Tei 2004 (4 criteria) and Reynolds 2004 (8 criteria) scoring rules plus thermodynamic asymmetry analysis (Schwarz/Khvorova 2003). Scans all 19-, 20-, and 21-mer windows, filters by GC content (30–52% default), ranks by composite score (max 13), and assigns efficacy tiers A–D. Input: FASTA file or raw mRNA sequence. Output: ranked candidates CSV, scoring summary JSON, and design report.

anchor.input_types: h5ad
anchor.description: STATE (arc-state) is a virtual cell model that predicts single-cell transcriptomic responses to perturbations including gene knockdown, drug treatment, and CRISPR edits. Takes an AnnData h5ad file with scRNA-seq data and a perturbation column label, and outputs a simulated h5ad with predicted post-perturbation expression profiles. Also supports generating latent cell embeddings. Input: AnnData h5ad. Output: simulated h5ad + optional predictions CSV.

anchor.input_types: smiles,txt
anchor.description: LLM-powered retrosynthesis planning tool that uses Gemini to propose multi-step synthesis routes for drug molecules given a SMILES string. Supports single-molecule and batch mode. Requires GEMINI_API_KEY. Input: SMILES string (single) or SMILES list file (batch). Output: synthesis route JSON + human-readable text plan.

Multi-evidence target prioritization chain for indication expansion. Integrates GWAS genetic evidence (GWAS Catalog + OpenTargets Genetics), eQTL colocalization (GTEx v10 + eQTLGen), and single-cell RNA-seq cell-type specificity (CellxGene Census) to rank candidate genes across multiple diseases. Outputs a 3-layer evidence matrix, indication priority ranking, and mechanistic cell-type hypothesis. Designed for target identification across related indications (e.g. MG, CIDP, GBS) and subpopulation-driven target differentiation.

PBPK model with peripheral nerve, spinal cord, and neuromuscular junction compartments. Extends standard 8-compartment PBPK with blood-nerve barrier (BNB) permeability, disease-state modifiers (CIDP increases BNB 3x), and nerve-specific compartments (endoneurium, DRG, NMJ). Validated for GalNAc-siRNA, ASO, mAb, and complement inhibitor biodistribution. Outputs nerve:plasma AUC ratio, BNB penetration assessment, and NCA parameters for all compartments.

anchor.input_types: geo_accession
anchor.description: GEO auto-fetch + pseudobulk aggregation. Downloads a GEO accession (e.g. GSE227835), aggregates scRNA-seq cells to pseudobulk counts per sample, and outputs three CSVs (counts_matrix.csv, sample_metadata.csv, contrasts.csv) ready for nf-core/differentialabundance.

Open Targets Platform GraphQL v4 evidence acquisition. Resolves a disease name to an EFO/MONDO id (search), then queries associatedTargets for per-datatype association scores + the target-prioritisation panel. Emits target_evidence.csv in the exact schema target_scorecard_ranker ingests (gene, genetic_support, biological_relevance, tractability, safety_liability, notes). biological_relevance = OT weighted-harmonic sum under a 'discovery' datatype profile (clinical datatype zeroed so novel mechanisms lead). Real urllib call; stdlib python; no fabricated rows.

Transparent, coverage-aware target-ranking engine. Fuses per-target multi-omic evidence (genetic_support, cell_specificity, expression, biological_relevance, tractability, safety_liability) into a ranked, provenance-backed scorecard via a normalised weighted harmonic sum (OpenTargets association-score method; Nelson 2015 genetic support; Oprea TDL 2018). Advisory second opinion via harmonic-sum or Random-Walk-with-Restart over an optional network. Reads evidence from --evidence_file (absolute host path) OR an optional STAGED path input that overrides it (race-free chain hand-off on AWS Batch).
